title: Yoo et al. v. Korean Southwest Orange County Presbytery
disposition_detail: Found administratively out of order and dismissed: no documentation that the complaint was first made to the presbytery under BCO 43-2, and the Presbytery is the proper court for the charges and specifications in the March 2, 2020 letter. Dismissed 19-0-0; TE Ross not qualified/disqualified under OMSJC 2.3(b). No merits reached.
first_summary: The SJC dismissed a complaint against Korean Southwest Orange County Presbytery because the complainants did not document that they first made it to presbytery under BCO 43-2. It also said the charges in a March 2, 2020 letter belonged to the Presbytery. The case was dismissed 19-0-0.
summary: The SJC found the complaint administratively out of order and dismissed it. The complainants had not documented that they first presented the complaint to Korean Southwest Orange County Presbytery under BCO 43-2, and the SJC held that the Presbytery—not the SJC—was the proper court for the charges and specifications in the March 2, 2020 letter. The dismissal was recorded 19-0-0; no merits were reached.
